ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible ventral surface exhibits a ratio of approximately 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal lobe tips to 70% low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal tips of both lobes contain contiguous high-intensity white regions. Right distal tip shows vertical low-intensity linear streaks. Left distal tip shows diagonal low-intensity streaks and blotches. Central region is a solid, low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate 70-degree interior angle and significant depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible margin. Significant high-amplitude notches are present on the upper boundary of the left lobe approximately 60% of the way from center to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve; initial concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to convex curvature at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) visible on the extreme outer margins of both lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct black linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation at the distal tips; right lobe contains two prominent parallel vertical lines, left lobe contains multiple unaligned diagonal strokes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating tissue loss or old trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'parallel line' black pigmentation pattern on the far right distal white field.
